L'essentiel pour comprendre SEN GP avant: The essentials for understanding SEN GP before creating a shipment or a trip.
SEN GP est une plateforme qui met en rel: SEN GP is a platform that connects parcel senders with international travellers. You describe your shipment in the app, the team matches it with a carrier whose trip fits, and you track the parcel through to handover.
Un GP (gros porteur) est un voyageur qui: A GP (gros porteur) is a traveller who carries parcels on their trip, within the weight limit they stated in the app. They receive missions, accept or decline them, then validate each step through to handover.

Au départ de Dakar, SEN GP couvre six co: From Dakar, SEN GP covers six continents, with their countries and regions (including the regions of Senegal). See the <a1>Destinations and prices</a1> page for reference prices; the final price is shown in the app before confirmation.
L'application propose plusieurs types de: The app offers several parcel types (documents, boxes, luggage, etc.). Dangerous or illegal items, or items prohibited on air transport, cannot be sent; the detailed rules are set out in the <a1>terms of use (in French)</a1>.
